what: Two initials built from isometrically stacked cube blocks take turns on a CreateJS canvas (500×500 stage, 60fps, 625 frames ≈10.4s loop). The first letter sways -6°→+6° over 99 frames with cubicInOut, then spins -186° over 29 frames with cubicIn and exits at .5x scale. The second letter enters at 174° and .5x over 30 frames with cubicOut, sways ±6° for 120 frames each way, then exits, and the first letter returns over 54 frames with cubicOut. Cells inside the letter strokes flow like a conveyor, one cell per 59 frames (the first cell grows, the last cell shrinks to .6x and exits). Four candy-colored decorations orbit around on a 320-frame elliptical path (1.07x in front, .46x behind, fading), and five fixed ones tilt and bob with 90~120 frame cubicInOut. In still mode only one frame is drawn

options.first: First letter (name in GLYPHS), default A — more letters can be added to GLYPHS in fx.js as block cells
options.letter: Text to draw when still (same as first)
options.still: If true, no rotation and a single sheet only — decoration for footer · over text
options.scale: Ratio of the still text to the panel, default .86
options.wait: Starts spinning when this event name arrives at the element (e.g. fx:play) — immediately if absent
options.--fx-candy-a ~ --fx-candy-e: Five decorative shape colors (css variables) — default is candy colors rotated from the hue of --kf-accent

from.where: index.html .t-hero__canvas — hero block initial letter (original Adobe Animate obj_4, starts together with the title’s first letter and turns on at 1s) · the footer .l-footerItems__main on every page and detail.html .c-fixedBg__obj are still
